mostWorthwhile.text: Testing both operating loads against usable battery capacity made the overnight reliability claim convincing, rather than treating a powered link as proof it would last.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the batteries, chargers and radios was clear but somewhat predictable; the separate assembly steps were less engaging than testing the finished link.

surprise.text: The solar inputs were ready, but the panels would add no energy overnight; the link depended on the measured reserves instead.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. I did need to inspect the configured link to discover the final load test, but the test itself had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The practical testing had a satisfying payoff in Eli's reply, and Tin Row's offer makes me curious how the networks will share information.
